measures.name: Air Time % (CH21)

measures.name: Departures Performed (thousands)

measures.name: FTE % to Total

measures.name: FTEs
measures.dax: SUM('Main Data'[# Equivalent FTEs])

measures.name: # of Flights (units)
measures.dax: DIVIDE([# of Flights], 1)

measures.name: # of Flights (thousands)
measures.dax: DIVIDE([# of Flights], 1000)

measures.name: # of Flights (millions)
measures.dax: DIVIDE([# of Flights], 1000000)

measures.name: Selected Metric
measures.dax: SWITCH(SELECTEDVALUE('INLFED-1'[eMetric]), "eDeparturesPerformed", DIVIDE([# of Flights], 1000), "eEnplanedPassengers", DIVIDE(SUM('Main Data'[# Transported Passengers]), 1000000), "eAirTime", DIVIDE(SUM('Main Data'[# Air Time]), SUM('Main Data'[# Ramp-To-Ramp Time])))

measures.name: Participation to the whole
measures.dax: DIVIDE([# of Flights], CALCULATE([# of Flights], ALLSELECTED()))

measures.name: % vs the Carrier's whole
measures.dax: DIVIDE([# of Flights], IF(ISINSCOPE('Carrier Groups'[Carrier Group]), IF(ISINSCOPE('Main Data'[Carrier Name]), CALCULATE([# of Flights], ALLSELECTED(), VALUES('Carrier Groups'[Carrier Group]), VALUES('Main Data'[Carrier Name])), CALCULATE([# of Flights], ALLSELECTED(), VALUES('Carrier Groups'[Carrier Group]))), IF(ISINSCOPE('Main Data'[Carrier Name]), CALCULATE([# of Flights], ALLSELECTED(), VALUES('Main Data'[Carrier Name])), CALCULATE([# of Flights], ALLSELECTED()))))

measures.name: % vs the Carrier's whole per year
measures.dax: DIVIDE([# of Flights], IF(ISINSCOPE('Carrier Groups'[Carrier Group]), IF(ISINSCOPE('Main Data'[Carrier Name]), IF(ISINSCOPE('Master Calendar'[Year]), CALCULATE([# of Flights], ALLSELECTED(), VALUES('Carrier Groups'[Carrier Group]), VALUES('Main Data'[Carrier Name]), VALUES('Master Calendar'[Year])), CALCULATE([# of Flights], ALLSELECTED(), VALUES('Carrier Groups'[Carrier Group]), VALUES('Main Data'[Carrier Name]))), IF(ISINSCOPE('Master Calendar'[Year]), CALCULATE([# of Flights], ALLSELECTED(), VALUES('Carrier Groups'[Carrier Group]), VALUES('Master Calendar'[Year])), CALCULATE([# of Flights], ALLSELECTED(), VALUES('Carrier Groups'[Carrier Group])))), IF(ISINSCOPE('Main Data'[Carrier Name]), IF(ISINSCOPE('Master Calendar'[Year]), CALCULATE([# of Flights], ALLSELECTED(), VALUES('Main Data'[Carrier Name]), VALUES('Master Calendar'[Year])), CALCULATE([# of Flights], ALLSELECTED(), VALUES('Main Data'[Carrier Name]))), IF(ISINSCOPE('Master Calendar'[Year]), CALCULATE([# of Flights], ALLSELECTED(), VALUES('Master Calendar'[Year])), CALCULATE([# of Flights], ALLSELECTED())))))

measures.name: # of Carriers
measures.dax: IF((ISFILTERED('Carrier State Count'[Carrier State Count]) || ISFILTERED('Carrier State Count'[Carrier State Count])) || (ISFILTERED('Carrier State Count Band'[Carrier State Count Band]) || ISFILTERED('Carrier State Count Band'[Low])) || (ISFILTERED('Carrier Load Factor Band'[Carrier Load Factor Band]) || ISFILTERED('Carrier Load Factor Band'[Low])), COUNTROWS(FILTER(VALUES('Main Data'[Carrier Name]), NOT ISBLANK('Main Data'[Carrier Name]) && (NOT (ISFILTERED('Carrier State Count'[Carrier State Count]) || ISFILTERED('Carrier State Count'[Carrier State Count])) || (CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNTNOBLANK('Main Data'[From - To State Code])) + 0) IN VALUES('Carrier State Count'[Carrier State Count])) && (NOT (ISFILTERED('Carrier State Count Band'[Carrier State Count Band]) || ISFILTERED('Carrier State Count Band'[Low])) || (FLOOR(CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNTNOBLANK('Main Data'[From - To State Code])) + 0, 100)) IN VALUES('Carrier State Count Band'[Low])) && (NOT (ISFILTERED('Carrier Load Factor Band'[Carrier Load Factor Band]) || ISFILTERED('Carrier Load Factor Band'[Low])) || (VAR lf = CALCULATE(DIVIDE(SUM('Main Data'[# Transported Passengers]), SUM('Main Data'[# Available Seats]))) RETURN IF(ISBLANK(lf), BLANK(), FLOOR(lf * 100, 10))) IN VALUES('Carrier Load Factor Band'[Low])))), DISTINCTCOUNTNOBLANK('Main Data'[Carrier Name]))

measures.name: Average Load Factor per Route
measures.dax: AVERAGEX(FILTER(ADDCOLUMNS(SUMMARIZE('Main Data', Airlines[Airline], 'Main Data'[From - To Airport ID]), "@lf", CALCULATE(DIVIDE(SUM('Main Data'[# Transported Passengers]), SUM('Main Data'[# Available Seats])))), NOT ISBLANK([@lf])), [@lf])

measures.name: Dimensionality
measures.dax: IF(NOT ISEMPTY('Main Data'), INT(ISINSCOPE('Carrier Groups'[Carrier Group])) + INT(ISINSCOPE(Airlines[Airline])) + INT(ISINSCOPE('Main Data'[Origin Country])) + INT(ISINSCOPE('Main Data'[Destination Country])) + INT(ISINSCOPE('Aircraft Types'[Aircraft Name])))

measures.name: Avg Load Factor per Route (by level)
measures.dax: SWITCH(INT(ISINSCOPE('Flight Types'[Flight Type])) + INT(ISINSCOPE('Carrier Groups'[Carrier Group])) + INT(ISINSCOPE('Main Data'[Carrier Name])), 0, AVERAGEX(FILTER(ADDCOLUMNS(SUMMARIZE('Main Data', 'Main Data'[From - To Airport ID]), "@lf", CALCULATE(DIVIDE(SUM('Main Data'[# Transported Passengers]), SUM('Main Data'[# Available Seats])))), NOT ISBLANK([@lf])), [@lf]), 1, AVERAGEX(FILTER(ADDCOLUMNS(SUMMARIZE('Main Data', 'Main Data'[From - To Airport ID], 'Flight Types'[Flight Type]), "@lf", CALCULATE(DIVIDE(SUM('Main Data'[# Transported Passengers]), SUM('Main Data'[# Available Seats])))), NOT ISBLANK([@lf])), [@lf]), 2, AVERAGEX(FILTER(ADDCOLUMNS(SUMMARIZE('Main Data', 'Main Data'[From - To Airport ID], 'Flight Types'[Flight Type], 'Carrier Groups'[Carrier Group]), "@lf", CALCULATE(DIVIDE(SUM('Main Data'[# Transported Passengers]), SUM('Main Data'[# Available Seats])))), NOT ISBLANK([@lf])), [@lf]), 3, AVERAGEX(FILTER(ADDCOLUMNS(SUMMARIZE('Main Data', 'Main Data'[From - To Airport ID], 'Carrier Groups'[Carrier Group], 'Flight Types'[Flight Type], 'Main Data'[Carrier Name]), "@lf", CALCULATE(DIVIDE(SUM('Main Data'[# Transported Passengers]), SUM('Main Data'[# Available Seats])))), NOT ISBLANK([@lf])), [@lf]))

measures.name: Latin America 2011 + Domestic 2010 excl. Foreign

semantic_gaps: Section Access -> RLS roles named after the Qlik USERIDs (ADMIN, DF, DU, IF, NOCARRIER) filtering INLFED[%FLIGHTTYPE]; passwords are not migrated, role membership is assigned in the Power BI service. '*' means every %FLIGHTTYPE value listed in Section Access, so ADMIN and NOCARRIER see the four flight types and, like in QlikView, not the Employment Statistics rows of Main Data (they have no %Datasource ID). Users outside every role (dataset owners) see all rows, which QlikView never showed in this document.

OMIT Carrier Name (NOCARRIER) -> object-level security: Carrier Name has columnPermission none for that role; measures and calculated columns that reference it fail for that role instead of returning null as in QlikView.

Master Calendar: QlikView keeps one row per day (1,065) because the script's LOAD DISTINCTs sit under a non-distinct preceding Load *; Power BI keeps one row per month (36) so Period can be the one side of the relationship. Measures over Main Data are unaffected; counts over calendar rows would differ.

Dimension rows: each role also filters every dimension and the calendars to the keys its facts use, as QlikView's reduction does (Airlines 336 named members under ADMIN). The 12 flight rows without a carrier group / airline point at a placeholder member (key -1, null label) so the filtered dimensions keep them, as the null row QlikView shows. The script's null-key 'Unknown' members are not loaded: they associate with nothing in QlikView and would wrongly match blank keys in Power BI.

Set analysis value modifiers use KEEPFILTERS: identical to QlikView with no selections (the parity baseline); with a slicer selection on the same field Power BI intersects where QlikView replaces the selection.

Point-in-time sets (vSetYTD, vSetLYYTD, vSetMTD, vSetLYMTD, vSetPreviousMonth, vSetPreviousNMonth) are defined in ..\0.Includes\SetVariables.txt, which is not in the repo; their definitions are reconstructed (see parity/models/<app>.overlay.json) and the measures implement the same reconstruction.
Alternate states Group A / Group B -> disconnected 'Group A' / 'Group B' period tables used as slicers; the measures intersect the main selection with the group's periods ({[Group A] * $}).

Calculated dimensions: the Aggr()/Class() carrier buckets -> disconnected segment tables; '# of Carriers' counts the carriers whose value falls in the segment at query time, so RLS and selections apply as in QlikView. The row-level Flight Type deal status -> calculated column on Flight Types.
Dimensionality()/Pick(Dimensionality()+1, ...) -> ISINSCOPE() over the chart's dimension fields.
$($(=eMetric)) -> SWITCH over SELECTEDVALUE('INLFED-1'[eMetric]); blank without a single Metric Name selected, like QlikView's empty expansion.
